import csv, json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/services/catalogue-google-group-id-delivery')
source = json.loads((root / 'merchant-api-field-evidence.json').read_text())
assert source['capture_hash_matches']
expected = '  // Shared identifier for all variants of the same product.\n  optional string item_group_id = 27;'
assert any(field['verbatim'] == expected for field in source['field_declarations_with_comments'])
output = root / 'fictional-inputs'
output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for name, second_group in [('consistent', 'LAMP-100'), ('conflicting', 'LAMP-200')]:
    with (output / (name + '.csv')).open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as handle:
        rows = csv.writer(handle)
        rows.writerow(['id', 'supplied_family_label', 'color', 'item_group_id'])
        rows.writerow(['LAMP-100-BLUE', 'LAMP-FAMILY', 'Blue', 'LAMP-100'])
        rows.writerow(['LAMP-100-GREEN', 'LAMP-FAMILY', 'Green', second_group])
print('Staged paired fictional inputs with a single item_group_id change. Existing merchant controls have not run on these inputs.')
